releases.summary: Establishes the first evidence-oriented catalog release after cross-platform hash-bound catalog verification passed.
changes: Published the current metadata-only catalog, documentation, examples, and checksum-bound availability feed.
Made catalog hashes stable across Windows and Unix checkouts for deterministic Rust and browser verification.
Added visible version, release date, last-published date, and permanent human- and machine-readable release histories.
Kept model artifacts outside the public deployment closure; the catalog remains metadata and discovery only.
